      <style>
        .slideshow-gallery {
          position: relative;
          width: 100%;
          height: 625px;
          overflow: hidden;
          margin-bottom: -1.5rem
          }
        
        .slideshow-gallery .slide {
          position: absolute;
          width: 100%;
          height: 100%;
          display: none;
          justify-content: center;
          align-items: center;
          }
        
        .slideshow-gallery .slide.active {
          display: flex;
          }
        
        .slideshow-gallery img {
          width: 100%;
          height: 100%;
          object-fit: cover;
          }
        
        /* Dots navigation */
          .slideshow-gallery .dots {
            position: absolute;
            bottom: 15px;
            width: 100%;
            text-align: center;
            z-index: 2;
            }
            
          .slideshow-gallery .dots span {
            height: 12px;
            width: 12px;
            margin: 0 5px;
            display: inline-block;
            background: #bbb;
            border-radius: 50%;
            cursor: pointer;
            transition: background 0.3s;
            }
            
          .slideshow-gallery .dots span.active {
            background: #fff;
            }
        
          .slideshow-gallery .slide-text {
            position: absolute;
            width: 100%;
            height:100%;
            text-align: center;
            color: white;
            text-shadow: 1px 1px 2px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.3);
            z-index: 1;
            padding: 10px 20px;
            background: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.3);
            }
            
          .slideshow-gallery h3 {
          font-size: clamp(2.5rem, 5vw, 5rem); 
          font-weight: bold;
          margin-top:13rem;
          margin-bottom: 0.2rem;
          }
          
          .slideshow-gallery p {
          font-size: clamp(1rem, 2vw, 1.5rem);   
          }
            
      </style>      
      
      <script>
      const slides = document.querySelectorAll('.slideshow-gallery .slide');
      const dots = document.querySelectorAll('.slideshow-gallery .dots span');
      let index = 0;
      
      function showSlide(n) {
          slides.forEach((slide, i) => {
              slide.classList.toggle('active', i === n);
              // If dots are still desired, keep this line:
              dots[i].classList.toggle('active', i === n);
          });
          index = n;
      }
      
      // Initial display of the first slide
      showSlide(index);
      
      // Automatic slideshow functionality
      const slideInterval = setInterval(() => {
          showSlide((index + 1) % slides.length);
      }, 4000); // Change 3000 to adjust the slide transition speed in milliseconds (e.g., 5000 for 5 seconds)
      
      // If dot navigation is also to be removed, delete the following block:
      dots.forEach((dot, i) => dot.onclick = () => showSlide(i));
      </script>
